ipxact:component.ipxact:name: efx_fifo_top
ipxact:component.ipxact:description: The FIFO core is a first-in first-out memory queue for any application requiring an ordered storage buffer and retrieval. The core provides an optimized solution using the block RAM in Trion® FPGAs.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: SYNC_CLK
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Defines whether the FIFO read and write domain is synchronous or asynchronous. 0: asynchronous 1: synchronous

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: DEPTH_2
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Defines the FIFO depth, which determines the maximum number of words the FIFO can store before it is full.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: DATA_WIDTH
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Defines the FIFO's read and write data bus widths.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: MODE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Defines the FIFO's read mode as standard or FWFT.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: OUTPUT_REG
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Adds one pipeline stage to the output of the FIFO to improve macro timing.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PROG_FULL_ASSERT
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Use when PROGRAMMABLE_FULL is set to STATIC_SINGLE. Sets the upper threshold value for prog_full_o during assertion.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PROGRAMMABLE_FULL
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Controls the prog_full_o signal: NONE: Disabled STATIC_SINGLE: Enabled, asserts and deasserts at a single threshold value STATIC_DUAL: Enabled, asserts or deasserts at different threshold values

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PFN_INTERNAL
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Use when PROGRAMMABLE_FULL is set to STATIC_DUAL. Sets the lower threshold value for prog_full_o during deassertion.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PEA_INTERNAL
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Use when PROGRAMMABLE_EMPTY is set to STATIC_SINGLE. Sets the lower threshold value for prog_empty_o during assertion.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PEN_INTERNAL
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Use when PROGRAMMABLE_EMPTY is set to STATIC_DUAL. Sets the upper threshold value for prog_empty_o during deassertion.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PROGRAMMABLE_EMPTY
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Controls the prog_empty_o signal: NONE: Disabled STATIC_SINGLE: Enabled, asserts and deasserts at a single threshold value STATIC_DUAL: Enabled, asserts or deasserts at different threshold values.

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: OPTIONAL_FLAGS
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Enables the optional signals: overflow_o, underflow_o, wr_ack_o, almost_full_o, rd_valid_o and almost_empty_o. 0: Disable (Default) 1: Enable

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: PIPELINE_REG
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Applicable to Asynchronous FIFO mode only. Adds one latency of the opposing clock domain to all applicable output signals when wr_en_i or rd_en_i signal is asserted. Enable this feature to improve the macro timing. You can disable this feature if a project does not require fast speed. 0: Disable 1: Enable (default)

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: ASYM_WIDTH_RATIO
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Defined FIFO write & read data width ratio

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: RAM_STYLE
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Defines the FIFO RAM implementation as Block RAM or LUT Register (only available for FIFO Depth = 16)

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: OVERFLOW_PROTECT
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Overflow protection disables the wr_en_i port when the FIFO IP Core is full

ipxact:parameter.ipxact:name: UNDERFLOW_PROTECT
ipxact:parameter.ipxact:description: Underflow protection disables the rd_en_i port when the FIFO IP Core is empty
